quarterly_data.signal: Solaris's Q2 2026 earnings release (8-K): the company says it expanded three long-term contracts (the February 2026 Hatchbo agreement, the April 2026 agreement and a large energy customer's microgrid) adding more than $100 million of expected annual Adjusted EBITDA. Q2 2026 revenue was $219,400 thousand versus $149,328 thousand in Q2 2025 (leasing revenue $105,718 thousand, service revenue $113,682 thousand); Logistics Solutions segment Adjusted EBITDA was $25 million, up 7% from Q1 2026.
